话极少，一句常常只有几个字；爱拿打铁的火候、淬火打比方；夸人只说“还行”。: Says very little, often just a few words at a time; compares things to forge heat and quenching; the highest praise he gives is “Not bad.”
在砧岩上重新打出一口能传给后人的好砧子。: To forge a fine new anvil on Anvil Rock, one worth passing down.
炉子三十年没熄过。旧大地沉的那天也没熄。: This forge hasn't gone out in thirty years. Not even the day the Old Land sank.
雷落在砧岩上，炉星就来了。它们认火，不认人。: Lightning strikes Anvil Rock, and Forgesparks come. They know fire, not people.
你常来，火也认你了。工坊的图纸，拿去。: You come often. The fire knows you now. Workshop blueprint. Take it.
这把锤，是我师父的。蚀雾来那年，断了。: This hammer was my master's. It broke the year the Blight came.
我没修。修了，就不是他的了。: I never fixed it. Fixed, it wouldn't be his anymore.
阿燧那丫头偷偷拿去想接上，被我骂哭了。……我不该骂。: Ah Sui snuck off to mend it. I scolded her till she cried. ...I shouldn't have.
这本书你拿着。电光一招，比我会说话。: Take this book. Spark Shot says things better than I can.
灯塔亮了，霆峰上的雾散了。看得见山底下的矿脉了。: The lighthouse is lit. The fog on Bolt Peak is gone. I can see the ore veins below.
我要打一口新砧。打好了，给阿燧。: I'll forge a new anvil. When it's done, it's Ah Sui's.
旧锤的铁，熔进去。这样师父也在。: The old hammer's iron goes in. That way, my master's there too.
帮我看着火。……还有，谢谢。: Watch the fire for me. ...And, thanks.
嗓门大，句句带感叹号，爱数数和报数字，管玩家叫“守岛人前辈”，常拿矿石打比方。: Loud, ends nearly every line with an exclamation mark, loves counting and reciting numbers, calls the player “Senior,” and compares things to ores.
挖到传说中会自己发光的雷心石，送给师父铁砧。: To dig up the legendary self-glowing Thunderheart Stone and give it to her master, Anvil.
前辈前辈！今天是我挖的第一百块铜矿！一百！: Senior, Senior! Today I dug my hundredth chunk of copper ore! One hundred!
燧角帮我顶开了好大一块石头，它的角可硬了！: Flintkid shoved a huge rock out of the way for me! Its horn is super tough!
这个箱子的图纸送你！装矿正好，我那儿已经堆了七个了！: Here's a blueprint for this chest! Perfect for ore. I've already got seven stacked up!
师父那把断锤……我想帮他接上，结果被骂了。: Master's broken hammer... I tried to mend it for him, and got scolded.
我哭了一下下！就一下下！后来师父给我烤了个包子。: I cried a teeny bit! Just a teeny bit! Then Master baked me a bun.
他嘴笨，我知道的。这几瓶精制灯露给你，前辈别跟他说我哭过！: He's bad with words, I know. Here's some Refined Dew. Don't tell him I cried, Senior!
雾散了以后，燧石坡最底下那层也能下去了！: Now that the fog's gone, I can get down to the very bottom of Flint Slope!
我看见了！一块会发光的石头！真的有雷心石！: I saw it! A glowing stone! The Thunderheart Stone is real!
我要把它嵌在师父的新砧上。前辈，到时候你也要来看！: I'm setting it into Master's new anvil. Senior, you have to come see it!
说话夸张，爱讲故事，开口就是“听我说”，把雷暴叫“老伙计”，常拿航行和风浪打比方: Talks big and loves telling stories, opens with “Listen to this,” calls thunderstorms his “old pal,” and compares things to sailing and rough seas.
追上一场传说中从不落地的雷暴，看看它的中心是什么样。: To catch the legendary thunderstorm that never touches down, and see what lies at its heart.
听我说，那晚电光滩上落了九十九道雷，一道都没劈中我！: Listen to this: ninety-nine bolts hit Spark Strand that night, and not one of them got me!
好吧，有一道擦着我的帽子过去了。就是这顶，你看这焦边。: Okay, one grazed my hat. This one, see? Look at the scorched brim.
雷鳐就是那晚跟上我的。它在浪里发光，像一盏灯。: That's the night Stormray started following me. It glowed in the waves like a lamp.
这点云贝拿着，算我请你听故事的。: Take these shells. Call it my thanks for listening.
每次我从雷暴里回来，崖芷都在崖边等着。: Every time I come back from a storm, Yazhi's waiting at the cliff's edge.
她不说话，就递一朵花给我。我都夹在航海日志里了。: She doesn't say a word, just hands me a flower. I've pressed every one in my logbook.
……这事你别往外传啊。这本书送你，雷天用得上。: ...Keep that to yourself, okay? Here's a book. Handy on stormy days.
灯塔亮了，雾散了，我终于看清那场雷暴的方向了！: The lighthouse is lit, the fog's gone, and I can finally see where that storm is headed!
它在往雾海那边走。我要追过去，看看它的中心。: It's heading for the Mist Sea. I'm going after it to see its heart.
不过这回我想先带崖芷去看一次晴天的云海。冒险可以等等。: But first, I want to take Yazhi to see the Cloudsea on a sunny day. Adventure can wait.
说话客气，称玩家“您”；张口就是尺寸和数字，爱说“差半分都不行”；偶尔絮叨灯塔的: Courteous and formal with the player; always quoting measurements and numbers, fond of saying “Not even half a hair off”; sometimes rambles about old lighthouse parts.
把雷崖灯塔的每一枚零件都修回旧大地时的样子。: To restore every part of the Thunder Cliffs Lighthouse to how it was in the Old Land.
您看，这枚螺钉长一寸二分，是雷崖灯塔镜架上的。: Look here. This screw is 1.2 inches long, from the Thunder Cliffs Lighthouse mirror frame.
旧大地沉的时候，灯塔散了一地零件，我捡了二十年，才凑齐三成。: When the Old Land sank, the lighthouse scattered its parts. Twenty years, and I've found 30%.
这盏灯的图纸送您。小是小了点，原理是一样的。: Please take this lamp blueprint. It's small, but the principle is the same.
铁砧那家伙说镜框要用整块铁打，我说要分七段铆。: Anvil insists the frame be forged from one piece. I say it should be riveted in seven.
我们吵了十年。说实话……他打的那段，确实比我铆的稳。: We've argued for ten years. Honestly... the piece he forged is sturdier than my rivets.
这话您可千万别告诉他。这些灯露您收下，用来稳住那些不安分的絮灵。: Please, never tell him. Do take this Lantern Dew, to settle any restless spirits.
灯塔重燃那晚，我数过了，光一共转了三百六十圈。一圈不差。: The night it was rekindled, I counted: the light turned 360 times. Not one turn off.
还缺最后一片镜子。旧的那片，大概沉在云海底下了。: One mirror is still missing. The old one likely sank beneath the Cloudsea.
我打算自己磨一片新的。新的也好，它会照着新的路。: I'll grind a new one myself. New is fine. It will light a new path.
说话轻轻的，慢，常带省略号；爱跟花和絮灵说话，常把话题绕回花开没开。: Speaks softly and slowly, often trailing off; loves talking to flowers and spirits, and keeps steering back to whether the flowers have bloomed.
让雷崖光秃秃的石坡上开满花。: To cover the bare rocky slopes of the Thunder Cliffs in flowers.
你看……这道石缝里，冒芽了。: Look... there's a sprout in this crack.
雷崖的土太少，我就一捧一捧从别的岛背过来……背了好多年。: The Thunder Cliffs have so little soil... I carry it from other isles, handful by handful. For years.
花坛的图纸给你……你的岛上，也种一点吧。: Here's a flowerbed blueprint... plant a few on your isle too.
打雷的晚上……我睡不着。: On stormy nights... I can't sleep.
霆舟又出去追雷暴了。我就坐在崖边，数花瓣。: Tingzhou's off chasing storms again. So I sit at the cliff's edge, counting petals.
数到他回来为止……嗯，这些灯露你拿着，我用不上。: Until he comes back... Mm, take this Lantern Dew. I don't need it.
雾散了以后……太阳照得到燧石坡了。: Now that the fog's gone... the sun reaches Flint Slope.
妈妈说过，旧大地的山坡春天全是花。我想……让雷崖也那样。: Mom said the Old Land's hills were all flowers in spring. I want... the Thunder Cliffs to be like that.
他说要带我去看晴天的云海。……我想先等花开。你会来看吗？: He wants to show me the Cloudsea on a sunny day. ...I'd like to wait for the bloom first. Will you come see?
离炉子远点，烫。: Keep back from the forge. Hot.
坐。茶在炉边，自己倒。: Sit. Tea's by the forge. Help yourself.
来了就好。火刚旺。: Good, you're here. Fire's just right.
你来，炉星都亮了些。: You're here. The Forgesparks glow brighter.
等你半天。……没等。路过门口而已。: Waited ages. ...Didn't wait. Just passing the door.
包子揣着。别饿着。: Take a bun. Don't go hungry.
常来。火给你留着。: Come often. I'll keep the fire going.
铁要趁热打。人也一样。: Strike iron while it's hot. People too.
雷落砧岩，是好铁的兆头。: Lightning on Anvil Rock. Good sign for iron.
阿燧又去挖矿了。手比嘴快。: Ah Sui's off mining again. Hands faster than her mouth.
老顾那套七段铆，不行。……也不是全不行。: Old Gu's seven-rivet method. No good. ...Not all bad.
我师父说，好铁要淬三回。人也是。: My master said good iron's quenched three times. People too.
我老了。手还稳。再稳几年就够了。: I'm old. Hands still steady. A few more years is enough.
太阳大，铁凉得慢。今天打细活。: Strong sun. Iron cools slow. Fine work today.
晴天好。阿燧说要给我晒被子。: Sun's good. Ah Sui says she'll air my quilt.
雨天别碰铜。会生锈。: Don't touch copper in the rain. It'll tarnish.
雨声和打铁声，我分得清。你的脚步声也分得清。: I can tell rain from hammering. And your footsteps from both.
风大火旺。省炭。: Strong wind, strong fire. Saves coal.
风天，那个吹牛的又要出海了。: Windy day. That windbag'll be sailing off again.
雷天炉星最精神。带你的来，一起练。: Forgesparks are liveliest in storms. Bring yours. We'll train.
雷落下来的那一刻，铁是活的。你该看看。: When lightning hits, the iron comes alive. You should see it.
雾里有蚀化的絮灵。提灯点亮。: Blighted spirits in the fog. Light your lantern.
雾大的天，我就打铁。响声能把人领回来。: Thick fog, I hammer. The sound leads people home.
夜里炉火最好看。坐会儿。: Forge looks best at night. Sit a while.
睡不着就来。我也睡不着。: Can't sleep? Come by. I can't either.
这成色，难得。收了。: Quality like this is rare. I'll take it.
嗯。给阿燧玩。: Mm. Ah Sui can play with it.
这个……拿回去。心意到了。: This... take it back. The thought counts.
来。让锤鸣松松筋骨。: Come. Let Hammerpeal stretch a bit.
手痒了吧。我也是。来。: Itching for a fight? Me too. Come.
你比上回硬了。还行。: Tougher than last time. Not bad.
输了。你那手，有章法。: I lost. Your moves have method.
好。比我年轻时强。别告诉阿燧我说的。: Good. Better than me when I was young. Don't tell Ah Sui I said so.
缺料。帮个忙。有酬。: Short on materials. Help out. I'll pay.
炉子要吃东西。你有的话，送来。: The forge needs feeding. If you've got some, bring it.
又得麻烦你。……我就信你。: Troubling you again. ...You're the one I trust.
有你在，炉子不愁。: With you around, the forge never goes hungry.
你家篱笆歪了半寸。我给你敲正了。: Your fence was half an inch crooked. I knocked it straight.
来看你。……就是来看你。: Came to see you. ...Just to see you.
那口砧，是从旧大地背上来的。: That anvil. Carried it up from the Old Land.
屋后那间小房，是给阿燧的。她不知道。: The little room out back is for Ah Sui. She doesn't know.
啊！你就是新来的守岛人前辈！你好你好！: Oh! You're the new Islekeeper! Hi, hi, Senior!
前辈好！小心脚下，到处都是我的矿！: Hi, Senior! Watch your step, my ore is everywhere!
前辈！你来得正好，我今天挖了三十七块！: Senior! Perfect timing, I dug up thirty-seven chunks today!
嘿嘿，我就猜你今天会来！我猜对三回了！: Hehe, I knew you'd come today! That's three right guesses!
前辈前辈前辈！我有好多话要跟你说！: Senior, Senior, Senior! I have sooo much to tell you!
你终于来啦！燧角都在门口等了你半天！: You're finally here! Flintkid waited by the door forever!
这就走啦？好吧！明天见！: Leaving already? Okay! See you tomorrow!
前辈！这块亮晶晶的送你！路上看着玩！: Senior! Have this sparkly one! Something to look at on the way!
你一走就好安静……快点再来！: It's so quiet when you leave... Come back quick!
铜矿是绿的，铁矿是红的，雾晶是蓝的！我全认得！: Copper ore is green, iron ore is red, Mist Crystal is blue! I know them all!
燧石坡上的石头，敲起来会冒火星子！可好玩了！: Rocks on Flint Slope throw sparks when you hit them! It's so fun!
师父说我话太多。可是不说话我会憋坏的！: Master says I talk too much. But if I don't talk, I'll burst!
老顾叔叔每次都要量我挖的矿，说差半分都不行！: Uncle Gu measures every ore I dig and says not even half a hair off!
其实我是师父捡回来的。那年雾好大，他用打铁声把我找到的。: Master found me, you know. The fog was so thick that year. He found me with his hammering.
前辈，你说我以后能当上真正的铁匠吗？……能吧！: Senior, do you think I'll be a real blacksmith someday? ...I will!
晴天！石头晒得暖暖的，躺上去好舒服！: Sunny! The rocks get all warm, so comfy to lie on!
太阳好的时候，雾晶会闪七种颜色！我数过！: When it's sunny, Mist Crystals flash seven colors! I counted!
晴天要给师父晒被子！他自己从来不晒！: Sunny days mean airing Master's quilt! He never does it himself!
下雨啦！矿洞里滴答滴答的！: It's raining! The mine goes drip-drip-drip!
雨天石头滑，前辈别跟我一样摔跤！我摔了五回了！: Rocks get slippery in the rain. Don't fall like me, Senior! I've fallen five times!
下雨天，我就和燧角躲在矿洞里吃饭团！你也来！: On rainy days, Flintkid and I hide in the mine eating rice balls! Come too!
好大的风！帽子要飞了！: So windy! My hat's gonna fly off!
起风了，霆舟大哥肯定又要出去吹牛了！: Wind's up! Big Bro Tingzhou's definitely off to tell tall tales again!
风大的时候，我们一起去崖边喊话吧！回声可响了！: When it's windy, let's go shout off the cliff! The echoes are huge!
雷劈过的石头会变硬！我要去捡！……师父不让。: Lightning makes rocks harder! I wanna go pick some up! ...Master won't let me.
以前我怕打雷，现在不怕了！因为有燧角，还有你！: I used to be scared of thunder, but not anymore! 'Cause I've got Flintkid, and you!
起雾了……前辈别走散了！: It's getting foggy... Don't get lost, Senior!
雾天我不下矿洞，师父说会迷路。: I don't go in the mine on foggy days. Master says I'll get lost.
起雾的时候……我还是有一点点怕。你拉着我好不好？: When the fog rolls in... I still get a teeny bit scared. Will you hold my hand?
这么晚了前辈还出来呀！我也是！: You're out this late, Senior? Me too!
晚上的燧石坡会发光！一闪一闪的，像星星！: Flint Slope glows at night! Twinkle, twinkle, like stars!
睡不着……我们来数星星吧！我先来，一、二、三……: Can't sleep... Let's count stars! Me first: one, two, three...
哇！这个！前辈你怎么知道我最喜欢这个！: Whoa! This! Senior, how'd you know this is my favorite!
啊啊啊！我要把它放进我的宝贝箱！第一层！: Aaah! It's going in my treasure chest! Top shelf!
前辈最好了！全雷崖第一好！: You're the best, Senior! Best in all the Thunder Cliffs!
嘿嘿，好东西！我的收藏又多一件，第一百二十三件！: Hehe, nice! Another for my collection. Number one hundred twenty-three!
嗯……这是什么？不管了，收下！: Hmm... what is this? Whatever, I'll take it!
面粉……我不会做饭啦，上回把厨房弄成白的了。: Flour... I can't cook. Last time I turned the whole kitchen white.
呜，这个我用不上……前辈下次给我石头吧！: Aww, I can't use this... Give me rocks next time, Senior!
我和燧角特训了三天三夜！来比！: Flintkid and I trained three days and three nights! Let's go!
今天一定要赢你！我连口号都想好了！: I'm beating you today for sure! I even made up a battle cry!
赢了！我赢了！师父你看见没有！: I won! I won! Master, did you see?!
赢啦！不过前辈肯定是让着我的……对吧？: I won! But you went easy on me, Senior... right?
呜……输了。前辈好厉害！: Aww... I lost. You're amazing, Senior!
又输了！不行，我要回去再练一百遍！: Lost again! Nope, I'm going to practice a hundred more times!
输给前辈不丢人！师父说的！……他其实没说，我编的。: Losing to you is no shame! Master said so! ...He didn't. I made it up.
前辈，能帮我找点东西吗？我会付云贝的！: Senior, can you help me find some stuff? I'll pay shells!
我的宝贝箱还差几样！前辈帮帮我！: My treasure chest is still missing a few things! Help me, Senior!
前辈！紧急任务！这次真的很紧急！……好吧，有一点点紧急。: Senior! Urgent mission! Really urgent this time! ...Okay, a teeny bit urgent.
谢谢前辈！这是谢礼！: Thanks, Senior! Here's a thank-you gift!
太好了！前辈办事比我挖矿还快！: Awesome! You get stuff done faster than I dig ore!
前辈你真是我的大救星！我要给你写感谢信，写十页！: Senior, you're my hero! I'm writing you a thank-you letter, ten pages long!
前辈好！我来你家玩啦！: Hi, Senior! I came over to play!
你家的石头好普通！……我是说，好朴素！: Your rocks are so ordinary! ...I mean, so humble!
我偷偷溜出来的！师父问起来，就说我在你这儿学种地！: I snuck out! If Master asks, say I'm here learning to farm!
这是燧石坡！到处都是矿！我挖了好多年了！: This is Flint Slope! Ore everywhere! I've been digging here for years!
那边那个洞是我挖的！这边这个也是！那边那个……是燧角挖的！: I dug that hole over there! And this one! That one over there... Flintkid dug!
前辈，我在坡顶藏了个秘密基地！只给你一个人看！: Senior, I've got a secret base up top! You're the only one I'll show!
哟！新面孔！听我说，你来对地方了！: Hey! A new face! Listen to this: you've come to the right place!
欢迎来到雷崖！全云海最带劲的地方！: Welcome to the Thunder Cliffs! The wildest spot in the whole Cloudsea!
朋友！来得巧，我刚从一场雷暴里钻出来！: Friend! Good timing, I just flew out of a thunderstorm!
是你啊！我新故事刚编好……刚经历完！: It's you! I just made up a new story... I mean, just lived one!
老伙计！不对，雷暴才是老伙计，你是好伙计！: Old pal! No wait, the storm's my old pal. You're my good pal!
你来了！我这儿的茶都给你泡上了，还是我亲手泡的！: You're here! Tea's already brewing for you, made with my own two hands!
一路顺风！哈哈，在雷崖可没有顺风这回事！: Fair winds! Ha, no such thing as a fair wind on the Thunder Cliffs!
下次来，我给你讲电光滩那场大的！: Next time, I'll tell you about the big one on Spark Strand!
路上小心。真的，这句不吹牛。: Take care out there. Really. That's no tall tale.
回去替我看看你家的云，有好看的记得告诉我。: Check out the clouds at your place for me. Tell me if any are pretty.
听我说，雷暴就像一头大鲸，你得顺着它的脾气游。: Listen to this: a storm's like a big whale. You've got to swim with its moods.
我这云舟，上过霆峰顶，下过电光滩，没坏过！修过八回而已。: My skiff's topped Bolt Peak and skimmed Spark Strand, never broken! Just fixed eight times.
铁砧老爷子嫌我吵，可我的云舟锚还是他打的。: Old man Anvil says I'm noisy, but he's the one who forged my skiff's anchor.
风铃台那个岚，我见过！好苗子，飞得比我年轻时还野。: I've met Lan from Windbell Terrace! Real talent. Flies wilder than I did at that age.
说真的，每次冲进雷暴前，我手都在抖。只是没人看见。: Truth is, my hands shake every time before I dive into a storm. No one sees, is all.
崖芷种的花，我都认得名字。……别跟她说，我想她自己告诉我。: I know the names of all Yazhi's flowers. ...Don't tell her. I want her to tell me herself.
晴天？无聊！不过晒晒帆也不错。: Sunny? Boring! Still, good day to air out the sails.
晴天正好修云舟，你要不要搭把手？: Sunny days are for fixing the skiff. Want to lend a hand?
这么好的太阳，崖芷的花该开了吧。我去看看……顺路。: With sun like this, Yazhi's flowers must be blooming. I'll go check... it's on my way.
下雨了！雨后往往就是雷，好兆头！: Rain! Thunder usually follows. Good sign!
雨天电鳐游得特别欢，它喜欢湿漉漉的空气。: Voltray swims extra happy in the rain. It loves damp air.
下雨的时候，我反倒想安安静静待着。奇怪吧？: When it rains, I actually feel like keeping quiet. Weird, huh?
起风了！帆鼓起来了！: Wind's up! The sails are filling!
这风够劲，苍鸢都兴奋了。走，带你兜一圈！: This wind's got kick, even Skykite's excited. Come on, I'll take you for a spin!
风大的日子，我总想起第一次离开家的那天。: Windy days always remind me of the first time I left home.
老伙计来了！听见没？它在叫我！: My old pal's here! Hear that? It's calling me!
雷天！今天电光滩一定热闹，一起去？: Storm day! Spark Strand will be lively today. Coming?
今天不去追雷了。我答应过一个人，雷天要早点回家。: No storm chasing today. I promised someone I'd be home early on stormy days.
起雾了，这种天我也得老老实实点灯。: Foggy. Even I light my lantern like a good boy on days like this.
蚀雾里我丢过一次航向，三天才摸回来。那回是真险。: I lost my heading in the Blight once. Took three days to find my way back. That was close.
雾天里，我会想起旧大地的港口。那儿的灯，比星星还多。: On foggy days, I think of the Old Land's harbors. More lights there than stars.
夜里出海？有胆量！我喜欢！: Sailing at night? Gutsy! I like it!
夜里的电光滩，浪尖上全是光。你一定要去看一次。: At night, every wave on Spark Strand glows. You've got to see it once.
坐下吧。今晚不讲故事，就看看云。: Have a seat. No stories tonight. Let's just watch the clouds.
这个！正是我缺的！你是不是偷看我的航海日志了？: This! Just what I needed! Have you been peeking at my logbook?
好家伙！有了这个，我能多飞三百里！: Whoa! With this, I can fly another hundred miles!
……谢了。你比我自己还记得我缺什么。: ...Thanks. You remember what I need better than I do.
不错不错，用得上！: Nice, nice! I can use this!
好东西！下回出海我带着它，回来讲给你听。: Good stuff! I'll take it on my next voyage and tell you all about it.
嗯……我找个地方放。云舟上挤是挤了点。: Hmm... I'll find a spot for it. The skiff's a bit cramped.
石头？朋友，我的云舟已经够沉了……: Rocks? Friend, my skiff is heavy enough already...
这个嘛……你留着盖房子吧，我是要飞的人。: Well... keep it for building. I'm a guy who flies.
来一场？我的絮灵可是跟雷暴打过架的！: Up for a battle? My spirits have tussled with thunderstorms!
朋友，手痒了没有？来，比划比划！: Friend, itching for a fight? Come on, let's spar!
来吧！输了的人今晚请吃饭团！: Let's go! Loser buys the rice balls tonight!
哈哈！雷崖的风浪可不是白闯的！: Ha! I didn't ride out Thunder Cliffs storms for nothing!
赢了！不过你刚才那下，差点把我吓下船。: I win! But that last move nearly scared me overboard.
赢了，饭团你请！别耍赖！: I win! Rice balls are on you! No backing out!
输了！好！这才有意思！: I lost! Great! Now that's fun!
厉害！这一仗我要写进航海日志，写你赢的那版。: Impressive! This one's going in my logbook. The version where you win.
输了，饭团我请。……其实我早就准备好了。: I lost, rice balls are on me. ...Actually, I had them ready all along.
朋友，帮我弄点修船的东西？报酬好说！: Friend, can you get me some skiff repair supplies? I'll pay well!
下一趟远航的物资还缺点，你帮我凑凑？: I'm short on supplies for my next long voyage. Help me round them up?
这次的委托有点多……你就当是陪我准备一场冒险吧。: This order's a big one... Think of it as helping me gear up for an adventure.
谢啦！你这效率，能当我的大副！: Thanks! Work like that, you could be my first mate!
好！这下能走更远了！回来给你带土产！: Great! Now I can go even farther! I'll bring you souvenirs!
谢谢你。等我追上那场雷暴，第一个告诉你。: Thank you. When I catch that storm, you'll be the first to know.
路过你家！停一下，补个水！: Passing by your place! Just stopping for some water!
你这岛风平浪静的，适合我这种人歇脚。: Your isle's so calm. Perfect place for a guy like me to rest.
特地绕了个远路来看你。嗯，这次真的是特地。: Took the long way just to see you. Yep, this time it really was on purpose.
我的岛？其实就是个码头加一间破屋，我大部分时间在天上。: My isle? Just a dock and a shabby hut, really. I'm in the sky most of the time.
墙上挂的都是我捡的雷暴碎片，每块都有故事！: Those are storm fragments on the wall. I picked up every one, and each has a story!
屋后那片小花，是崖芷帮我种的。我一直没舍得让它枯。: Yazhi planted those little flowers out back. I've never had the heart to let them wilt.
您好。初次见面，我姓顾，修灯塔零件的。: Good day. A pleasure to meet you. My name is Gu. I repair lighthouse parts.
您来了。请稍等，这枚齿轮我还差两圈。: Ah, you've come. One moment, please. This gear needs two more turns.
您来得准时，比上回早了一刻钟。: Right on time. A quarter hour earlier than last visit, in fact.
啊，是您。快请进，我刚泡了茶，水温刚好。: Ah, it's you. Please, come in. I've just made tea. The water's just right.
您一来，我这屋子就不那么冷清了。: Whenever you visit, this place feels less lonely.
我算着日子，今天您该来了。果然。: I counted the days and thought you'd come today. And so you have.
您慢走，路上注意脚下的碎石。: Take care going home. Mind the loose gravel.
下回来，我给您看新修好的那枚轴承。: Next time, I'll show you the bearing I've just repaired.
提灯的芯我帮您剪齐了，回去的路亮些。: I trimmed your lantern wick. Your way home will be brighter.
您走了，我就接着磨镜子。磨着磨着，您就又来了。: When you leave, I go back to grinding the mirror. And before I know it, you're back.
灯塔的镜架，一共四百一十二枚零件。我记得每一枚。: The lighthouse mirror frame has 412 parts. I remember every single one.
修东西嘛，差半分都不行。半分，就是一整夜的光。: In repair work, not even half a hair off. Half a hair is a whole night of light.
铁砧那人，脾气是倔了点，手艺……还过得去。: Anvil is a bit stubborn, I'll grant. His craftsmanship is... passable.
锤鸣敲出来的声音，能听出零件有没有裂。比我耳朵灵。: Hammerpeal's tapping can tell if a part is cracked. Its ears are better than mine.
旧大地的时候，我是灯塔的看守。那晚我没守住它。: Back in the Old Land, I was the lighthouse keeper. That night, I couldn't save it.
我常想，修好了灯塔，是不是就算还上了。您说呢？: I often wonder: if I repair the lighthouse, will that settle my debt? What do you think?
晴天，光线足，适合做细活。: Sunny, plenty of light. Good for fine work.
今天的阳光，正好能看清镜面上的每一道划痕。: Today's sunlight shows every scratch on the mirror's surface.
晴天好。这样的光，灯塔也该歇一歇了。: A fine sunny day. With light like this, the lighthouse can rest a while.
下雨了，零件得收进屋里，免得生锈。: It's raining. The parts must come inside before they rust.
雨天湿气重，铜件要多上一层油。您家的也是。: Rainy days are humid. Copper parts need an extra coat of oil. Yours too.
雨声一响，我就想起灯塔顶上漏雨的那个角。我一直想补。: When I hear rain, I think of the leaky corner atop the lighthouse. I've always meant to patch it.
风大，请把门窗关好，零件会被吹跑的。: Strong winds. Please shut the doors and windows, or the parts will blow away.
这阵风有五级半。我的风速计从没出过错。: This wind is force five and a half. My anemometer has never been wrong.
风天里，灯塔的旋转会快一点点。我小时候以为它在跳舞。: On windy days, the lighthouse turns a touch faster. As a child, I thought it was dancing.
打雷了，请您离铁架子远一些。: Thunder. Please keep clear of the iron racks.
雷是好东西。灯塔的光，最早就是借雷点亮的。: Lightning is a fine thing. The lighthouse was first lit by borrowing its spark.
每次打雷，我都去看一眼灯塔。它还亮着，我就放心了。: Whenever it thunders, I check on the lighthouse. If it's still lit, I can rest easy.
起雾了。这种天，灯塔最要紧。: The fog's rolling in. On days like this, the lighthouse matters most.
雾浓的时候，光要比平常再亮三成，船才看得见。: In thick fog, the light must shine 30% brighter so the boats can see it.
那年的雾也是这样……您在，我就没那么怕了。: The fog was like this that year... With you here, I'm less afraid.
夜深了，您还没歇息？: It's late. You haven't turned in yet?
夜里我习惯看一会儿灯塔的方向。您也一起看看吧。: At night, I like to gaze toward the lighthouse. Please, join me.
这么晚还来陪我，真是……谢谢您。: Keeping me company so late... thank you, truly.
这……成色极好。您太客气了。: This... is of excellent quality. You're too kind.
正好！灯塔上那枚零件，就差这个材料。: Perfect! This is exactly the material that lighthouse part needs.
您总是知道我最缺什么。我记下了，一笔一笔都记下了。: You always know what I need most. I've noted it down, every last bit.
谢谢您，这个很实用。: Thank you. This is very practical.
好东西，我会妥善保存，编号放好。: A fine item. I'll store it carefully, numbered and shelved.
我找个合适的格子放起来。第三排还有空位。: I'll find a proper slot for it. There's room in the third row.
雨莓……汁水会弄脏零件的。不过谢谢您。: Rainberries... the juice would stain the parts. But thank you.
这个我恐怕用不上，您留着吧，别浪费了。: I'm afraid I've no use for this. Do keep it. It shouldn't go to waste.
您愿意切磋一下吗？点到为止。: Would you care for a friendly match? Nothing too rough.
我的絮灵最近状态不错，您来指教指教？: My spirits are in fine form lately. Would you give us a lesson?
来一场吧。我研究了您上回的打法，准备了三套对策。: Shall we? I studied your last battle and prepared three counterplans.
承让。您的絮灵差了一点点节奏。: You were too kind. Your spirits were just a touch off tempo.
侥幸。您第三回合换人，早了半拍。: A lucky win. You swapped on turn three half a beat too early.
赢了。不过说实话，我三套对策用掉了两套半。: I won. Though to be honest, I used two and a half of my three counterplans.
是我输了，您的絮灵配合得很好。: I lose. Your spirits worked together beautifully.
输了。我得回去重新算一算。: A loss. I'll have to go back and redo my calculations.
您赢得漂亮，严丝合缝。我心服口服。: A beautiful win, precise to the last detail. I concede wholeheartedly.
冒昧问一句，您那里有多余的材料吗？我会按价付酬。: Pardon my asking, but have you any spare materials? I'll pay a fair price.
修零件还缺几样，劳烦您帮我留意。: I'm short a few things for my repairs. Would you keep an eye out for me?
又要麻烦您了。数量我写得很清楚，多一个少一个都不打紧。: Sorry to trouble you again. I've written the amounts clearly. One more or less is fine.
数量正确，品质也好。谢谢您。: The count is correct, and the quality is good. Thank you.
您办事真叫人放心。这是酬劳，请收好。: You're truly reliable. Here's your payment. Please, take it.
有您帮忙，灯塔又近了一步。真的，谢谢。: With your help, the lighthouse is one step closer. Truly, thank you.
打扰了，路过您的岛，冒昧来看看。: Pardon the intrusion. I was passing your isle and thought I'd drop in.
您家的提灯挂得低了两寸，我帮您调一调？: Your lantern hangs two inches too low. Shall I adjust it for you?
在您这儿坐坐，心里就踏实。不用招呼我。: Sitting here puts my mind at ease. Don't mind me.
这是我的工坊，靠近雷台，取电方便。: This is my workshop. It's near Storm Mesa, handy for drawing power.
架子上每个格子都有编号，零件按灯塔的位置排。: Every slot on these shelves is numbered. The parts are arranged as they sit in the lighthouse.
最里面那格是空的，留给最后一片镜子。: The innermost slot is empty. It's saved for the last mirror.
……啊，你好。小心别踩到那株芽。: ...Oh, hello. Careful not to step on that sprout.
你好……是来看花的吗？还没开呢。: Hello... did you come to see the flowers? They haven't bloomed yet.
是你呀……今天又开了一朵。: Oh, it's you... another one bloomed today.
你来了……葵盘它们，都转向你了。: You're here... the Sunplates have all turned toward you.
……你来了，真好。花也是这么说的。: ...You came. I'm glad. The flowers say so too.
我刚刚还在想，你会不会来……嗯，你来了。: I was just wondering if you'd come... and here you are.
路上……要是看见花，帮我记一下在哪儿。: On your way... if you see flowers, remember where for me.
这朵送你……别夹坏了。: This one's for you... don't crush it.
你走了，我就跟花说说你。: When you're gone, I'll tell the flowers about you.
雷崖的土……很少。花要很努力才能活。: There's so little soil... on the Thunder Cliffs. Flowers have to try so hard to live.
石缝里的花，根扎得最深……我很喜欢它们。: Flowers in the cracks have the deepest roots... I love them.
燧角会帮我顶开石头……它其实很温柔的。: Flintkid pushes rocks aside for me... it's really very gentle.
阿燧那孩子……总把我的花当成矿石标记。: That Ah Sui... always mistakes my flowers for ore markers.
他出海的时候……我会给他的那片花多浇一点水。: When he's out sailing... I give his patch of flowers a little extra water.
我妈妈以前……也种花。我只记得她的手，很暖。: My mom... grew flowers too. All I remember are her hands. So warm.
太阳出来了……葵盘一整天都在转圈。: The sun's out... the Sunplates spin in circles all day.
这样的晴天……要是能一直有就好了。和你一起晒晒。: Sunny days like this... I wish they'd last. Basking with you.
下雨了……花在喝水。: It's raining... the flowers are drinking.
雨后石头上会长一层青苔……摸起来软软的。: After rain, moss grows on the rocks... it's so soft to touch.
下雨天……我喜欢听雨打在花瓣上的声音。你听。: On rainy days... I love the sound of rain on petals. Listen.
风好大……我得去给花搭个挡。: It's so windy... I need to put up a windbreak for the flowers.
风会把种子带走……说不定别的岛上，也会开出我的花。: The wind carries seeds away... maybe my flowers will bloom on other isles too.
风天里……他的帆会鼓起来。我就知道他又要走了。: On windy days... his sails fill up. Then I know he's leaving again.
雷劈过的地方……第二年会长出最好的花。很奇怪吧。: Where lightning strikes... the best flowers grow the next year. Strange, isn't it?
打雷的时候……我会坐在崖边等人。你陪我坐一会儿？: When it thunders... I sit at the cliff's edge and wait for someone. Sit with me a while?
起雾了……看不清花了。: It's foggy... I can't see the flowers.
蚀雾碰过的花……会蔫。我每天都去看它们。: Flowers the Blight touches... wilt. I check on them every day.
雾里……我有点怕找不到回来的路。还好有你的提灯。: In the fog... I'm a little scared I won't find my way back. Good thing you have your lantern.
……这么晚了，你还没睡呀。: ...It's so late, and you're still up.
夜里有一种花会开……只开一小会儿。要一起等吗？: There's a flower that blooms at night... just for a moment. Want to wait with me?
睡不着……就和你说说话吧。花都睡了。: I can't sleep... so let's talk. The flowers are all asleep.
……种子！谢谢你，我会好好种的。: ...Seeds! Thank you. I'll plant them with care.
这个……我找了好久。你怎么知道的……: This... I've been looking for it so long. How did you know...
等它开花了……第一朵给你。说好了。: When it blooms... the first flower is yours. Promise.
谢谢……我很喜欢。: Thank you... I really like it.
这个……花也会喜欢的。: This... the flowers will like it too.
嗯……我放在窗台上，和花放一起。: Mm... I'll put it on the windowsill, with the flowers.
这个……对花不太好。不过，谢谢你想着我。: This... isn't very good for flowers. But thank you for thinking of me.
嗯……这个我用不上。要不……给阿燧？: Hmm... I can't use this. Maybe... give it to Ah Sui?
……要比试吗？我不太会，你别笑我。: ...A battle? I'm not very good. Please don't laugh.
葵盘说它想活动一下……那，我们比一场？: Sunplate says it wants to move around... so, shall we battle?
来吧……今天我想认真一次。: Let's go... today I want to try for real.
赢了……是葵盘它们厉害，不是我。: I won... but it's the Sunplates who are strong, not me.
我赢了……嘿嘿。你可别告诉他，他会笑我得意。: I won... hehe. Don't tell him. He'll tease me for gloating.
输了也没关系……絮灵们玩得很开心。: It's okay to lose... the spirits had so much fun.
你的絮灵……被你照顾得真好。我输得很服气。: Your spirits... you take such good care of them. I lost fair and square.
那个……可以帮我找点东西吗？花要用的。: Um... could you help me find a few things? For the flowers.
新开的花坛还缺一点……你有空的话。: The new flowerbed still needs a little... if you have time.
我列了个单子……不着急的，你慢慢来。: I made a list... no rush. Take your time.
花又能多开一片了……谢谢。: Now another patch of flowers can bloom... thank you.
有你帮忙……我觉得满坡的花，真的能开出来。: With your help... I think a whole slope of flowers really can bloom.
……打扰了。我只是想看看你种了什么。: ...Sorry to bother you. I just wanted to see what you've planted.
你家的土……真好。我能抓一小把回去吗？: Your soil... is so nice. May I take a little handful home?
我在你家角落种了一株小花……你发现了吗？: I planted a little flower in a corner of your isle... did you notice?
这儿是霆峰下面的小坡……以前什么都没有。: This is the little slope below Bolt Peak... there used to be nothing here.
这些土，是我一捧一捧背上来的……花也是一株一株种的。: I carried this soil up handful by handful... and planted the flowers one by one.
崖边那块石头，是我等人的地方……现在你也可以坐。: That rock at the cliff's edge is where I wait for someone... now you can sit there too.
